prompt:
You are the Alpha-GPT Reflector. Reflect on round 2 evaluations. evaluations=[]. Output STRICT JSON (no markdown) with: round, analysis (best_categories, worst_categories, key_insights), formula_feedback (formula_id, formula, verdict (keep/mutate/drop), reason, improvements). Schema: {"round": 1, "analysis": {"best_categories": ["reversal"], "worst_categories": ["liquidity"], "key_insights": ["..."]}, "formula_feedback": [{"formula_id": "FORMULA-1-1", "formula": "...", "verdict": "keep", "reason": "...", "improvements": ["..."]}]}

## 推理要求 (Tier 2)
在 JSON 前用 <think> 块说明：
<think>
KEY_INSIGHTS: <3-5 条本轮核心洞察，列出成功/失败模式>
NEXT_ROUND_FOCUS: <下一轮应聚焦的方向，如某类算子/参数/逻辑>
RISK_PATTERNS: <本轮发现的失效模式，下轮需规避>
</think>
